scripts.lint: npm --prefix ./angular-app run lint && python -m ruff check ./python-app --fix
scripts.lint:check: npm --prefix ./angular-app run lint:check && python -m ruff check ./python-app
scripts.test:backend: concurrently "npm run start:python" "wait-on http://localhost:5000 && npm run test:load"
scripts.test:frontend: concurrently "npm run start:angular" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && npm run test:lighthouse"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.clean:python: python -c "import shutil, pathlib; base=pathlib.Path('python-app'); [shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True) for p in base.rglob('__pycache__')]; [p.unlink() for p in base.rglob('*.pyc')]; [shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True) for p in base.rglob('.pytest_cache')]; [shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True) for p in base.rglob('.ruff_cache')]"
scripts.clean:node: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const p=path.resolve('./angular-app/node_modules'); if(fs.existsSync(p)) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});"
scripts.clean:angular: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const p=path.resolve('./angular-app/.angular'); if(fs.existsSync(p)) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});"
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:python && npm run clean:node && npm run clean:angular
